preconditions.description: The number of tests t is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(n) <= 10**5 for n in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(result) <= int(n) for result, n in zip(stdout.split(), stdin.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: Each result is between 0 and the corresponding n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(int(result) == 1 or int(result) == 0 for result in stdout.split())
